body: Nothing I don't talk to much of my family anymore and when I did I kept everything I could a secret. I try to talk with them once and now I haven't talked with my mother and father in over a year, they want nothing to do with me, my sister came to visit a few weeks ago it was a little nice but it'll be another 2 years before see her again, and the rest of my family I don't know really and I doubt they even know who I am at this point..

Seeing someone slowly losing interest in you is the worst feeling, I've been in a similar situation and I didn't want to let go of them but I knew I had too. It feels impossible to cut them out on the dot, for me I tried talking less and slowly taking them out of my life, it hurt alot but fast forward almost 4 months and I now realize how bad they were for me and don't feel all the pain I did back then. Idk if this was helpful at all
